recipes.oracle_text: Counter target creature spell. Draw cards equal to that spell's mana value.

recipe_coverage: Whole Oracle text and source characteristics are pinned against the reviewed counter extension profile. Real casting/response windows cover both source controllers, own and opposing spells, full costs, insufficient mana, no stack, legal target relationships, exact zone receipts, populated-zone snapshots and printed immediate secondary effects.  Countered source spells, pending-target departure, protection/prevention interactions, replacement effects, other stack objects, control changes and multiplayer remain separate gaps.
